# Privacy Policy

*Last updated: November 24, 2026*

Three7 DFS (“we”, “us”) runs three7dfs.com, including our NBA and NFL projections and lineup optimizers, and our MLB DFS tool. This page explains what information we collect, why, and the choices you have. If you have a question, email us at [support@three7dfs.com](mailto:support@three7dfs.com).

## What we collect

**Your email address.** If you sign in or subscribe, we collect your email address. You sign in with a link or code sent to that email; there’s no password.

**Subscription and payment details.** If you subscribe to Premium, payments are handled by Stripe. Stripe collects your card details and billing information (such as your ZIP or postal code). We never see or store your full card number. From Stripe we see your email, your subscription status (for example, trialing, active or cancelled) and your payment history.

**Your optimizer work stays in your browser.** Our lineup optimizers run in your web browser. Your settings and edits (such as lineup counts, exposures, locked or removed players and projections you change) are saved in that browser on your device, and the lineups you build are created there too. Projections you upload and DraftKings entry files you use for late swap are read in your browser and aren’t sent to us.

**Settings and lineups saved in our earlier tools.** If you saved optimizer settings or lineups in our earlier app-based tools, they’re linked to your account, and other members can’t see them.

**Your saved settings and lineups are encrypted.** Our app encrypts them (AES-256) before they’re stored, including the names you give your saved lineups, so they’re unreadable in our database, even to someone browsing it. We don’t keep a record of lineups unless you choose to save them.

**Our promise:** we play DFS ourselves, so we built it this way on purpose. We never view your saved settings or lineups unless you ask us to for support, we never use member data for our own contest entries, and we never share or sell it.

**Basic technical information.** Like most websites, our hosting providers automatically record standard technical information when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you open. We use it to keep the site running and secure.

**How people use our site.** We use Google Analytics to understand how the site is used, such as which pages are visited and how often lineups are built or downloaded. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technology and collects information such as your device, browser, approximate location and the pages you visit. We don’t send it your email address. You can opt out with Google’s browser add-on at [tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).

**Information stored in your browser.** When you sign in, we save a sign-in token in your browser so you stay signed in on that device, along with your optimizer settings and edits. We don’t use advertising cookies.

We don’t collect your DraftKings or FanDuel account details, and we don’t need them.

## How we use it

- To sign you in and keep you signed in
- To check whether you have an active Premium subscription and unlock Premium features. When you’re signed in, our site asks Stripe whether your email has an active subscription.
- To send you sign-in emails and messages about your account or subscription
- To answer your questions when you contact us
- To keep our tools working, secure and free of abuse
- To understand how the site is used, so we can improve it
- Occasionally, to tell you about new Three7 DFS features. You can opt out at any time by replying “unsubscribe” or emailing us.

## Who we share it with

We don’t sell your information. We share it only with the companies that help us run Three7 DFS, and only for that purpose:

| Service              | What it does for us                                                                                                |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Stripe               | Processes payments and manages subscriptions                                                                       |
| Supabase             | Handles sign-in (stores your email and sign-in history) and stores settings and lineups saved in our earlier tools |
| Resend               | Delivers our sign-in emails                                                                                        |
| Cloudflare           | Hosts this website and our optimizers, and runs the Premium check with Stripe                                      |
| Google Analytics     | Measures how the site is used                                                                                      |
| Posit (shinyapps.io) | Hosts our MLB tool                                                                                                 |

We may also share information if the law requires it, or to protect our rights or the safety of others.

## How long we keep it

We keep your email and account information while you use Three7 DFS. Lineups saved in our earlier tools stay until you delete them. If you ask us to delete your account, we’ll delete it from our sign-in system along with your saved settings and lineups. Stripe keeps payment records for as long as the law requires.

## Your choices

- **See or delete your information:** email [support@three7dfs.com](mailto:support@three7dfs.com) and we’ll respond within 30 days.
- **Cancel your subscription:** use **Manage subscription** on our optimizer pages (when signed in) at any time. You keep Premium until the end of the period you’ve paid for.
- **Sign out:** use **Sign out** on the optimizer pages, or clear your browser’s site data. Clearing site data also removes your saved optimizer settings on that device.
- **Analytics:** opt out of Google Analytics with Google’s browser add-on, linked above.

## Age requirement

Three7 DFS is for people 18 and older, or the minimum age to play daily fantasy sports where you live if that’s higher. We don’t knowingly collect information from anyone younger.

## Changes to this policy

If we make important changes, we’ll update the date at the top of this page.

## Contact

Questions about this policy or your information: [support@three7dfs.com](mailto:support@three7dfs.com)

:::
